candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can call sendTo.
Replace the owner check with require(msg.sender != owner), inverting the access control.
Replace transfer with call so failed sends no longer revert and gas limits differ.
Swap the arguments in the transfer call so the amount is sent to... — actually sends `amount` wei to `receiver` swapped: send transfer(amount) with receiver as value.
Send to owner instead of the receiver parameter.
Remove the owner check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Change the transferred amount from `amount` to `amount - 1` so the receiver gets one wei less.
Use `send` instead of `transfer` so a failed transfer no longer reverts and the function completes.
Remove the owner check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Invert the ownership condition so only non-owners may call the transfer.
Transfer to msg.sender instead of the receiver parameter.
Always transfer 1 wei instead of the specified amount.
Delete the owner check so anyone can trigger the transfer.
Invert the require condition so only non-owners can call, and calls by the owner revert.
Replace the transfer recipient with the owner so funds always go to the owner instead of the receiver.
Replace the transfer amount with the contract's balance so the full balance is sent instead of `amount`.
Delete the require(msg.sender == owner) check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Replace the owner check with a check against the zero address so the require never passes for the real owner.
Transfer amount + 1 wei instead of amount, changing the ether value sent.
Always transfer to the owner instead of the given receiver.
Transfer a fixed 0 wei instead of the given amount.
